title: MTPA Control Reference
text: Compute reference currents for maximum torque per ampere (MTPA) and field-weakening operation, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Type of motor} sets the type, {Number of pole pairs} sets the number of available pole pairs, {Stator resistance per phase (Ohm)} sets the resistance of stator phase winding, {Stator d-axis inductance (H)} sets the d -axis stator winding, {Stator q-axis inductance (H)} sets the q -axis stator winding, {Permanent magnet flux linkage (Wb)} sets the magnetic flux linkage of permanent magnets, {Max current (A)} sets the maximum phase current limit for motor, {Vdc input method} sets the input method for Vdc Specify, {DC voltage (V)} sets the dC bus voltage, {Input signal units} sets the unit of block input values Per-Unit, {Base speed (rpm)} sets the base speed of motor, {Base current (A)} sets the base current for per-unit conversion, {Base torque (Nm)} sets the base torque for per-unit conversion, {Base voltage (V)} sets the base voltage for per-unit conversion and {Prioritise execution time} scales down computations to reduce algorithm execution. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Type of motor
params.values: Type of PMSM Interior PMSM (default) | Surface PMSM

params.name: Number of pole pairs
params.values: Number of available pole pairs 4 (default) | scalar

params.name: Stator resistance per phase (Ohm)
params.values: Resistance of stator phase winding (ohms) 0.36 (default) | scalar

params.name: Permanent magnet flux linkage (Wb)
params.values: Magnetic flux linkage of permanent magnets 6.4e-3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Max current (A)
params.values: Maximum phase current limit for motor (amperes) 7.1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Vdc input method
params.values: Input method for Vdc Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Input signal units
params.values: Unit of block input values Per-Unit (PU) (default) | SI Units

params.name: Base current (A)
params.values: Base current for per-unit conversion (amperes) 19.3 (default) | scalar

params.name: Base torque (Nm)
params.values: Base torque for per-unit conversion (Nm) 0.74112 (default) | scalar

params.name: Base voltage (V)
params.values: Base voltage for per-unit conversion (volts) 24/sqrt(3) (default) | scalar

params.name: Prioritise execution time
params.values: Scale down computations to reduce algorithm execution time on (default) | off
